name: Fortress Loans Chain price-feed submit() without signature verification

classification.summary: The Chain price-feed contract read by FortressPriceOracle had the validator-signature require in submit() commented out, so the attacker pushed an arbitrary FTS price and, with a governance proposal that had already made fFTS collateral, borrowed the protocol dry.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

limitations: Target identity and code history came from the v1 snapshot row originally at protocols/fortress-loans.json; no semantic revalidation was inherited.
The executing code artifact and its code hash have not been established in structured evidence.
One or more target block, transaction, ordering, or creator anchors remain unresolved.
